findings.what: Timing arithmetic for any late E10 find, as a reminder only (not a new rule). A CI/x138-family file has runtime L ~9.3-9.5 h (exp87a (9.30, 9.48] h) and a non-CI file ~7.0-7.2 h (exp85a). For its read to exist before the user ticks at 20:00Z, an E10 copy must be submitted by about 20:00 - 9.5 h = 10:30Z (CI-like) or 20:00 - 7.2 h ~ 12:45Z (non-CI-like). Build plus dummy (~30-35 min) come on top, and after 02:00Z the user also has to say yes. The e10_watch loop runs until 12:00Z and the feed loop until 23:59Z, which covers that window. A notebook that appears after ~12:00Z cannot be read before the tick, so it could enter the finals only blind, which the V_pub rule forbids (COMPLETE refs only).
